mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 2, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Two Palestinians killed as settlers, Israeli forces raid West Bank village. Teenagers killed in settlers attack on al-Mughayyer as West Bank violence continues. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. UK must end all trade with Israel, says co-founder of BDS movement. Exclusive: sanctions against ministers and settler groups are 'smoke and mirrors cop-out' says Omar Barghouti Britain's legal and ethical obligation to stop a genocide in Gaza requires it to take bigger steps than halting trade with illegal Israeli settlements or imposing further sanctions, Omar Barghouti, the co-founder of the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement has said. This was reported by The Guardian. 3. More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says. The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children. This was reported by BBC News. 4. Israel says Hamas.
